title: IT Operations Support Lead (Relocation to Singapore)
location: AU - Melbourne
field: -
description:
[under: About Airwallex] We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices.
[under: How you'll make impact] Airwallex IT Operations provides the technology support and site operations that help employees work effectively across our offices.
[under: How you'll make impact] - Own IT site operations, reliability and the employee technology experience for our Singapore office.
[under: How you'll make impact] - Drive escalated regional support for offices across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia, Vietnam and Indonesia, while partnering with the global IT team to resolve issues quickly.
[under: How you'll make impact] - Lead onboarding and offboarding, AV and events support, executive and VIP support, vendor management, procurement, inventory and office technology projects in partnership with Workplace, Information Security, People Operations, Facilities and Real Estate.
[under: How you'll make impact] You'll work from our Singapore office five days a week.
[under: Essentials] - Experience leading IT site operations or serving as the primary IT owner for a regional or remote office.
[under: Essentials] - Intermediate networking troubleshooting skills, including common Wi-Fi, DNS and office network issues.
[under: Essentials] - Experience providing on-site and remote technical support to employees and contractors.
[under: Essentials] - Experience supporting meeting rooms, all-hands spaces and other office technology.
[under: You'll thrive here if] - You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office five days a week.
